overrides.reason: 6.25% mandatory convertible preferred stock issued June 2026 for $19.1bn net converts into Class A/C shares by May 2029; it is not in the opening share count, so it is deducted as a claim at its issue value (about 0.45% of market value) instead of building the instrument-level capital structure.

Return on the new AI capital set near the measured incremental ROIC (24.7%) instead of the strong-moat rule (up to 40%): capex doubled to $44.9bn a quarter and free cash flow turned negative in Q2 2026, so the returns on this spending are not yet demonstrated.
Bear: AI infrastructure returns close to the cost of capital as capacity is competed down.
Bull: Cloud backlog converts at today's Cloud margins and AI lifts Search monetization.

moat.note: Search & other still grows 17% at $63bn a quarter with a 34% group operating margin; five-year average ROIC about 45% and gross margin stable within about 4pp (SEC data). Strength is in Search/YouTube margins; the open question is the return on AI capital spending, set separately through terminal ROIC.

technology_ai.note: Cloud revenue +82% with $513.9bn Cloud backlog (just over half within 24 months) shows paid AI demand; adoption figures are management statements.
